settings.s5: “Now the leaves were dense and green, hanging heavy over the road and mottling the light on his dashboard.”

settings.s14: “The bar was the kind of place Hemingway might have lingered a little too long, lights glittering on the crystal and glass.”
settings.s16: “In some ways, they were like night and day. She was cerebral, he was an artisan.”
settings.s18: “She brushed a few stray hairs into place, then ruffled her hair again, wanting to appear thoughtfully—artfully—effortless.”
settings.s20: “Leaning back in her seat, she sank her teeth into a ripe peach and remembered the afternoons, watching the clouds carousel across the sky.”
settings.s22: “She couldn’t know that she’d succeed, but she never doubted it, either. Chasing her dream felt as natural as breathing air.”
settings.s24: “She was waiting in the bed next to the open window, the down duvet ruffled around her like a snow drift.”
